simple.meaning: זִרְמָה (zirmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a gushing of fluid (semen).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H2231. zirmah זִרְמָה noun feminine issue (of semen virile ), in figure of the paramours of Jerusalem זִרְמָתָם סוּסִים וְזִרְמַת Ezek 23:20 .
